capture_outcome_replay.interpretation: Canonical categories remain fixed to the original paired400; capture outcomes are separately reported because evaluation topology and normal low-order numerical variation may move borderline success bits.

first_behavior_divergence.definition: First behavior divergence is the first replan whose matched macro25-vs-macro50 action RMS exceeds 1e-6.
first_behavior_divergence.interpretation: All captured policies differ before environment visitation can diverge; this does not identify which checkpoint action is correct.

interpretation_boundary: Action RMS is the matched disagreement between macro25 and macro50 on the fixed union of both rollout occupancies. It is not expert-action error because validation experts are unavailable and teacher actions were not read.

reference_boundary.analysis: matched macro25/macro50 action disagreement on fixed S25 union S50
reference_boundary.causal_limit: successful checkpoint behavior is a directional reference, not an expert-action oracle
